details:
日本人は下に原文書いてるからそっち読んでね。

Following the results of the previous survey—which, to be honest, were disappointing—I think you’re aware that, among more than 3,000 possible response variations, people submitted answers reflecting a wide range of opinions rather than a simple black-and-white stance on AI.

VRChat has also announced that it has no plans to implement a definitive “AI-generated” label.

With that in mind, this proposal is a compromise that addresses VRChat’s concern that implementing labels or filters could make worlds completely invisible to people who dislike AI.

I genuinely hate AI.

However, I understand that it would be unrealistic to track and regulate every instance of AI use, whether someone uses it for coding or as a brainstorming partner to create their ideal world, or whether they use material assets created by others with some AI assistance.

One of the official proposals was to introduce “Like” and “Dislike” options, but I believe this approach is problematic in its own right. I won’t go into the details of my reasoning here, but frankly, it could fuel the conflict between people who support AI and those who oppose it. It could also allow people to deliberately downvote worlds created by people they dislike for reasons entirely unrelated to AI, potentially using bots to manipulate the results.

Instead, I propose a system that allows visitors to submit their subjective estimate of how much AI they think was used in a world, based on their experience exploring it and examining its UI and textures. For example, they might think, “Hmm, it looks like around 30% of this world was made using AI,” and submit that estimate.

The collected data could then be displayed in a gradient-style graph with the following ranges:

* 0–10%

* 11–20%

    — Primarily human-made

* 21–30%

* 31–40%

    — AI used in some parts

* 41–100%

    — AI used extensively

Users could then choose from several filtering options based on this graph.

For example, if a world has received only a small number of votes, such as 10 or 20, the graph would remain hidden. This would help prevent worlds from being judged too readily based on limited data. The graph would only become visible once enough data had been collected—for instance, when estimates from at least 2,000 trusted users are available, using the trust system VRChat is planning to introduce.

Of course, this system would not prove whether the estimated AI usage percentage is accurate.

Even so, I believe this would be a better approach. Users who feel uncomfortable with AI could filter out worlds where AI usage is estimated to exceed 20%. However, “I don’t want to visit worlds where AI usage is estimated to exceed 20%” does not necessarily mean “I’ll visit worlds where AI usage is estimated at 20% or less.”

The filter would simply give users the option to make their own choices based on their comfort levels. At the same time, making AI usage more transparent could help minimize the decline in visits to worlds simply because they are perceived as AI-assisted.

Overall, I believe this would be preferable to introducing a negative “Dislike” feature that could hurt creators and further divide the community.

この前のアンケート結果を受けて（正直期待外れのものだった）、3000通り以上の回答結果が予想される中で「グラデーションある結果」が入力されたのは知ってると思う。

そしてVRChatはAI“断定”ラベルは今後実装するつもりはないと発表した。

その上でこれはVRChatの考える「ラベルやフィルターの実装をすると、嫌いな人間に完全に見られなくなる」懸念への折衷案です。

私はAIが本当に嫌いなんだけど、理想的なワールド製作のためにコーディングを任せたり相談相手として使ったり、他人が一部AIを使って製作したマテリアルアセットの利用まで把握と規制をするのは無理だろうと理解してる。

公式の出した対応の一つが「好き」「嫌い」の提案だったけれど、これはこれで不適切だと思ってる。

詳しい自分の見解は話さないけど、ぶっちゃけAIの賛成派反対派の対立を煽ることになるし、AI無関係に嫌いな人間のワールドをbotを使って意図的に下げる事も出来るからね。

その上で提案するのが、ワールドを訪れた人間がワールドを見て、その体験やUI表示やテクスチャから「うーん30%くらい使ってそうだなあ」という感情を入力できるシステムです。

このデータを

0〜10%

11〜20%

--------人の手で作られている

21〜30%

31〜40%

-------一部にAIを使っている

41〜100%

-------大部分にAIを利用している

というグラデーショングラフで見れるようにする。

そのグラフを利用した何択かのフィルターの設定。

例えば10人や20人という少ない時はグラフ非表示で、少なくとも人の目に触れやすくなり、信頼できるユーザー（VRChatが新たに実装しようとしている機能ね）2000人以上のデータが集まった時は表示させる。

もちろんAIの利用率が事実かどうかの証明にはならない。

それでもAIに忌避感を関じるユーザーが「20％以上の利用が予想されるワールドは嫌だなぁ」≠「20％以下なら行こうかな」

とフィルターを機能させつつAI利用を表向きにしてもvisit数の低下を抑えたり、「嫌い」なんてネガティブな要素でクリエイターを傷つけるより良いと思うんだけど。

（今までユーザーが作ってきた部分が大きいのだから、箱だけ用意して判断も対策もユーザーに任せたほうが楽でしょう？）
title: A Feature for Voting on the Estimated AI Usage Rate Based on Personal Opinion
